Shri Satya Prakash S/o Shri Devi Kishan Maheshwari, 90-  91 Subham Farms House, Pal Road, Jodhpur, P.s.
 Chopasni Housing Board, Jodhpur West, Jodhpur Raj..
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sunil Joshi For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, PP  Mr. Vishal Sharma for respondent  No.2  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 20/01/2023
An application for early disposal of the petition has been filed by counsel for the petitioner.
For the reasons and on the grounds as mentioned in the application, the application is allowed.
The matter is heard today itself.

The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing of FIR No.203/2016, Police Station Chopasni Housing Board, District Jodhpur West for offences under Sections 420, 465, 467,
468, 471, 474, 505 read with Section 120B of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Chopasni Housing Board, District Jodhpur West
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor has submitted a report dated 03.11.2022 received from the SHO, Police Station Chopasni (2 of 2) [CRLMP-3945/2016] Housing Board, District Jodhpur West wherein it has been mentioned that after thorough investigation Police has already submitted the final report in this case before the competent Court.
The said report is hereby taken on record.
